title: Primitive Recursiveness of Rank Parity
statement: For a bit string $s$, let $r(s)$ be the natural number obtained by appending a $1$ to $s$, interpreting the resulting string in least-significant-bit-first binary, and subtracting $1$. The function sending $s$ to the singleton list containing whether $r(s)$ is odd is primitive recursive.
